description_en: Constructed by Khaḍgikāra Gvārā in the 1940s, Bhajana Phalcā is currently being used for devotional singing dedicated exclusively to Buṅgadyaḥ.The Phalcā stands north of Patan’s Matsyendranātha Mandira (LAL0060) at Taḥ Bāhāḥ. Śrī Macchindranātha Mṛdaṅga Bhajana Maṇḍala, a group of devotional singers, is currently using the space of the Phalcā to sing devotional songs. Besides that, the Phalcā also houses the office of the Macchindra Bahāla Sudhāra Samiti, an office formed by the locals for the conservation of the area. A counter for selling water from the well (LAL4111-001) next to the Phalcā also operates from here.The construction of the Phalcā began in 1943 CE (VS 2000) after its foundation was dug up. Khaḍgīkāra Gvārā, Tulasimāyā, and the family from the Iti Ṭola constructed the Phalcā. Khaḍgīkāra built the Phalcā wishing his deceased grandfather Lāju and father Kuberasīṃ the heavenly abode of Sukhāvatī Bhuvana. The descendants of Khaḍgīkāra Gvārā still carry out the necessary repairs to the Phalcā. Motilāla Śilpakāra installed metal railings on the Phalcā in 1998 CE (VS 2054).The Bhajana Maṇḍala performs devotional songs here at the Phalcā every Sunday and Thursday evenings along with on auspicious days like the full moon. Beginning from the full moon day of Caitra, they perform hymns every day at the Phalcā until the chariot procession of Buṅgadyaḥ comes to an end. During this period, the 75 members of the Bhajana Maṇḍala sing hymns in praise of Buṅgadyaḥ at the Phalcā till the 1stof the bright fortnight of Vaiśākha, the day the statue of Buṅgadyaḥ is accessioned to the chariot. Then onwards, they go to the place where Buṅgadyaḥ is stationed to perform hymns. People from all caste and gender are eligible to be a member of the Bhajana Maṇḍala.
description_ne: विसं २००० (सन् १९४३) मा खड्गिकार ग्वाराले दिवंगत हजूरबुबा र बुबाको सुखावती भुवनमा बास् होस् भन्ने कामना गरी फल्चाको निर्माणको लागि जग खनेका थिए । अहिले श्री मच्छिन्द्रनाथ मृदङ्ग भजन मण्डलले यस फल्चामा भजन सञ्चालन गरिरहेको छ ।त: बाहा:मा रहेको मच्छिन्द्रनाथ मन्दिर (LAL0060) को उत्तरमा भजन फल्चा रहेको छ । श्री मच्छिन्द्रनाथ मृदङ्ग भजन मण्डलले फल्चामा भजन कार्यक्रम संचालन गरिरहेको छ । यसै फल्चामा मच्छिन्द्र बहाल सुधार समितिको कार्यालय पनि रहेको छ । फल्चासँगै रहेको इनार (LAL4111-001) को पानी बिक्री गर्ने काउन्टर पनि यसै फल्चामा राखिएको छ ।यो फल्चा निर्माण गर्न विसं २००० जेठ ११ गते (सन् १९४३) मा जग खनिएको थियो । इति टोलका खड्गिकार ग्वारा, तुलसिमाया र परिवारका अन्य सदस्यहरू मिलेर फल्चा निर्माण गरिएको थियो । खड्गिकार ग्वाराले दिवंगत हजूरबुबा लाजु र बुबा कुबेरसींको सुखावती भुवनमा बास् होस् भन्ने कामना गरी फल्चा निर्माण गरेका थिए । फल्चामा कुनै मर्मत गर्नुपरेमा खड्गिकार ग्वाराका सन्ततिहरूले गर्दै आइरहेका छन् । विसं २०५४ (सन् १९९८) मा मोतिलाल शिल्पकारले फल्चामा फलामको ढोका र रेलिङ्ग लगाइदिएका थिए ।यस फल्चामा श्री मच्छिन्द्रनाथ मृदङ्ग भजन मण्डलले प्रत्येक आइतवार र विहिवार बेलुकी भजन गर्दै आइरहेको छ । त्यस्तै पूर्णिमा, अष्टमी र संक्रान्तिको दिनमा पनि नियमित रूपले भजन गर्दै आइरहेको छ । चैत्र शुक्ल पूर्णिमादेखि बुङ्गद्य:को रथजात्रा समाप्त नभएसम्म दिनदिनै भजन गरिन्छ । वैशाख शुक्ल प्रतिपदासम्म यसै फल्चामा बसेर भजन गरिन्छ । त्यसपछिका दिनहरूमा बुंगद्य: जुन ठाउँमा राखिएको हुन्छ त्यसै ठाउँमा गएर भजन गरिन्छ । यस भजन मण्डलमा ७५ जना सदस्यहरू छन् । जातपात, क्षेत्र र लिङ्गको भेदभाव नराखी सबैजना यस भजन मण्डलमा सदस्य बन्न पाउने प्रावधान रहेको छ । भजन सञ्चालन गर्न ललितपुर महानगरपालिकाले वार्षिक १० हजार अनुदान दिइरहेको छ । उक्त रकम नपुग भएकोले चन्दा उठाएर भजन सञ्चालन भइरहेको छ ।

historical_events.event_description: The construction of the Phalcā started by digging the foundation as per the treatise on architecture. Khaḍgīkāra Gvārā from the Iti Ṭola, along with Tulasimāyā and the family constructed the Phalcā wishing his deceased grandfather Lāju and father Kuberasīṃ the heavenly abode of Sukhāvatī Bhuvana.

historical_events.event_name: Construction of a metal fence around Matsyendranātha Mandira (LAL0060)
historical_events.event_description: A committee named Śrī Macchindranātha Mandira Saṃrakṣaṇa Samiti was formed. The Samiti installed metal railings to surround the temple to protect the statues and other historic items from theft.

historical_events.event_name: Formation of Macchindra Bahāla Sudhāra Samiti
historical_events.event_description: Community members formed a committee named Macchindra Bahāla Sudhāra Samiti for the conservation of Matsyendranātha Mandira and other monuments in the area.

historical_events.event_name: Installation of metal grills and door
historical_events.event_description: Motilāla Śilpakāra sponsored the installation of metal grills and a door in thephalcā.
